summary: Reserve pairing and terminal attachment records for their dedicated operations.

replay.detail: Retained records remain readable; authentication and attachment authority require operation admission.

schema.detail: Member-local tables hold explicitly configured temporary migration allowances and local operation proof. Native system-only operation receipts bind pairing and terminal authority to exact records and issuing members; replication and backup admission require keyed signed receipt envelopes.

compatibility.detail: Ordinary claim writes cannot create pairing or terminal attachment records. Unmarked existing pairings require a new pairing unless explicitly included in a temporary migration allowance. Every allowance ends by 2026-11-15T23:00:00Z and preserves existing scopes, expiry and revocation. Unmarked terminal attachments require a new attach operation.

downtime.detail: Upgrade every member accepting client requests. Clients using unmarked credentials must pair again unless an operator has configured an exact existing completion allowance on that member.

manual.detail: Optional pairing_legacy_allowances entries contain the audited existing completion_id, record_hash and until_unix_ms, with the recorded person as writer. The default is empty. An allowance admits exactly the listed record contents, honors issuer revocation and never extends beyond the fixed deadline.

recovery.detail: Pair the device again or create a new terminal attachment through the dedicated operation. Remove temporary migration allowances after renewing pairings. On a standalone daemon, pairings and terminal attachments do not survive a backup restore and must be paired or attached again.
